description: We'e a pre-formed team of friends driven by our shared fascination with space missions, orbital mechanics, and video game design/development. Our strengths lie in collaborative problem-solving, creative ideation, and great team communication. We’re  really excited to tackle challenges inspired by the cosmos! Note: Our roster is currently full and we are not looking for new team members at this time, but we’re excited to connect with other space and gaming enthusiasts during the event!
